facts.fact: Dhanu's limp comes from a boyhood fall that was badly set: the right foot plants and the left swings out and round.
facts.why: needed because the outline gives the limp but no physical detail to show on the page.

facts.fact: Ila names the small unnamed yellow star above Ewe's Rest 'Mini' after Dhanu's daughter; Kunal says it will not go on the map.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Ila to name a star for Mini.

facts.fact: Ewe's Rest has a long main room with a central chulha and a sleeping shelf; the third house is cold and unused. The north side of the pen wall (shoulder high, about ninety paces round) has a footing a hand short of half its height, and Ila advises a flat-stone footing course a hand wide.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Ila to measure Gauri's pen wall and find the footing a hand short.

facts.fact: Dhanu's runner boy saw Raghu's two loaded pairs pass the upper fold two days ago, heading for the Hollow Moon; this matches Ila's estimate at the burned hut that they were a day ahead.
facts.why: needed because the beat ends on Dhanu's report of Raghu's pairs, and it must fit ch 5's timing.

facts.fact: Gauri calls Ila by her name for the first time after the wall is measured.
facts.why: needed to show Gauri's wariness turning to trust.
